tables.name: ai_usage_logs
tables.comment: Immutable ledger of AI feature consumption used for billing, analytics and cost reporting.

tables.name: billing_audit_logs
tables.comment: Append-only audit trail for all billing operations. Parent table for monthly partitions.

tables.name: usage_daily_counters
tables.comment: Historical daily usage counters. Parent table for monthly partitions.

tables.name: billing_features
tables.comment: Master catalog of all billable platform features and limits. Plans reference these features through entitlement records.

tables.name: billing_webhook_events
tables.comment: Inbox table for payment-provider webhooks. Ensures idempotent processing and reliable retry handling.

tables.name: coupon_applicable_plans
tables.comment: Defines which plan versions a coupon may be redeemed against.

tables.name: coupon_redemptions
tables.comment: Immutable history of coupon redemptions by organizations.

tables.name: coupons
tables.comment: Reusable promotional coupons supporting percentage and fixed discounts.

tables.name: invoices
tables.comment: Immutable invoice records generated for subscriptions. Monetary values are stored in the smallest currency unit.

tables.name: organization_subscriptions
tables.comment: Current and historical subscriptions owned by organizations.

tables.name: organization_usage_current_period
tables.comment: Single-row fast-path counters for each organization. Used during ingestion and quota checks to avoid aggregating historical usage.

tables.name: payments
tables.comment: Immutable payment ledger. Supports retries, refunds and reconciliation with external payment providers.

tables.name: plan_feature_entitlements
tables.comment: Resolved feature values for each billing plan. Every feature is represented by one row instead of JSON configuration.

tables.name: plan_prices
tables.comment:
Commercial pricing for subscription plans. Supports multiple providers,
currencies, billing intervals, regional pricing and future grandfathered prices.

tables.name: plans
tables.comment: Billing plans define commercial tiers and lifecycle metadata. Pricing and entitlements are stored in separate tables.

tables.name: project_connector_subscriptions
tables.comment: Project-level subscriptions to organization-owned connectors. No connector duplication.

tables.name: subscription_addons
tables.comment: Purchased add-ons that increase effective feature limits without changing the base plan.

tables.name: subscription_events
tables.comment: Immutable audit trail of all subscription lifecycle events. Rows are append-only.

tables.name: v_effective_entitlements
tables.comment: Resolved organization entitlements. Future revisions can merge active subscription add-ons.

SELECT COALESCE(p.project_id, s.project_id) AS project_id,
    COALESCE(p.org_id, s.org_id) AS org_id,
    COALESCE(p.counter_type, s.counter_type) AS counter_type,
    ((COALESCE(p.value, (0)::bigint))::numeric + COALESCE(s.unflushed_value, (0)::numeric)) AS total_value,
    p.period_start,
    p.period_end,
    p.updated_at AS last_flushed_at,
    now() AS queried_at
   FROM (project_usage p
     FULL JOIN ( SELECT usage_counter_staging.project_id,
            usage_counter_staging.org_id,
            usage_counter_staging.counter_type,
            date_trunc('hour'::text, usage_counter_staging.created_at) AS period_start,
            sum(usage_counter_staging.increment_by) AS unflushed_value
           FROM usage_counter_staging
          GROUP BY usage_counter_staging.project_id, usage_counter_staging.org_id, usage_counter_staging.counter_type, (date_trunc('hour'::text, usage_counter_staging.created_at))) s ON (((p.project_id = s.project_id) AND ((p.counter_type)::text = (s.counter_type)::text) AND (p.period_start = s.period_start))));

SELECT organization_id,
    period_start,
    period_end,
    events_used,
    event_limit,
    (event_limit - events_used) AS remaining_events,
    ai_credits_used,
    ai_credit_limit,
    (ai_credit_limit - ai_credits_used) AS remaining_ai_credits,
    projects_used,
    members_used,
    api_keys_used,
    connectors_used,
    alert_rules_used,
    dashboards_used
   FROM organization_usage_current_period;

SELECT os.organization_id,
    bf.feature_key,
    COALESCE(ofo.boolean_value, pfe.boolean_value) AS boolean_value,
    COALESCE(ofo.integer_value, pfe.integer_value) AS integer_value,
    COALESCE(ofo.decimal_value, pfe.decimal_value) AS decimal_value,
    COALESCE(ofo.string_value, pfe.string_value) AS string_value
   FROM ((((organization_subscriptions os
     JOIN plans p ON ((p.id = os.plan_id)))
     JOIN plan_feature_entitlements pfe ON ((pfe.plan_id = p.id)))
     JOIN billing_features bf ON ((bf.id = pfe.feature_id)))
     LEFT JOIN organization_feature_overrides ofo ON (((ofo.organization_id = os.organization_id) AND (ofo.feature_id = bf.id) AND (ofo.deleted_at IS NULL) AND ((ofo.expires_at IS NULL) OR (ofo.expires_at > now())))))
  WHERE (os.status = ANY (ARRAY['trialing'::billing_subscription_status, 'active'::billing_subscription_status, 'past_due'::billing_subscription_status]));

SELECT os.organization_id,
    p.name AS plan_name,
    p.key AS plan_key,
    p.tier,
    os.status,
    os.billing_interval,
    os.current_period_start,
    os.current_period_end,
    os.cancel_at_period_end
   FROM (organization_subscriptions os
     JOIN plans p ON ((p.id = os.plan_id)));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consume_ai_credits(p_organization_id uuid, p_credits bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
UPDATE organization_usage_current_period
SET ai_credits_used = ai_credits_used + p_credits,
    last_ai_request_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.flush_usage_counters()
 RETURNS TABLE(flushed_project_id uuid, flushed_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH batch AS (
    SELECT id, project_id, org_id, counter_type, increment_by, created_at
    FROM usage_counter_staging
    WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 seconds'
    ORDER BY id
    LIMIT 10000
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  ),
  aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      project_id,
      org_id,
      counter_type,
      date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS period_start,
      date_trunc('hour', created_at) + INTERVAL '1 hour' AS period_end,
      SUM(increment_by) AS total_increment
    FROM batch
    GROUP BY project_id, org_id, counter_type, date_trunc('hour', created_at)
  ),
  upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO project_usage
      (project_id, org_id, counter_type, period_start, period_end, value, updated_at)
    SELECT project_id, org_id, counter_type, period_start, period_end, total_increment, NOW()
    FROM aggregated
    ON CONFLICT (project_id, counter_type, period_start)
    DO UPDATE SET value = project_usage.value + EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING project_id
  ),
  deleted AS (
    DELETE FROM usage_counter_staging s
    USING batch b
    WHERE s.id = b.id
    RETURNING s.id, s.project_id
  )
  SELECT d.project_id, COUNT(*)::BIGINT
  FROM deleted d
  GROUP BY d.project_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_effective_integer_feature(p_organization_id uuid, p_feature_key text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
SELECT integer_value
FROM v_effective_entitlements
WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id
  AND feature_key = p_feature_key
LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_feature(p_organization_id uuid, p_feature_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
SELECT COALESCE(boolean_value,FALSE)
FROM v_effective_entitlements
WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id
  AND feature_key = p_feature_key
LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_event_usage(p_organization_id uuid, p_count bigint DEFAULT 1)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
UPDATE organization_usage_current_period
SET events_used = events_used + p_count,
    last_event_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remaining_ai_credits(p_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
SELECT GREATEST(ai_credit_limit - ai_credits_used,0)
FROM organization_usage_current_period
WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id;
$function$
